summary: Phase 2 Vision Document for the April Dunford expansion extraction. Analyzes the new source transcript against the existing 5-workflow skill domain to identify 8 new genius patterns, 6 new hidden knowledge items, and proposes 8 new workflows across 3 tiers (Foundation, Practitioner, Stacking). Includes a full uniqueness audit, business leverage map, cross-expert stacking opportunities with 12+ existing agents, and gap fill analysis showing coverage expansion from B2B-only positioning to universal positioning intelligence applicable across all domains.
